data.title: KSrelief Distributes Food Aid to Newly Displaced Families in Yemen's Lahj
data.content:
Lahj, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 129 food baskets on Friday to newly displaced families in Lahj Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 903 individuals from 129 families as part of the emergency response project in Yemen.
    The assistance is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian and relief efforts, carried out through its humanitarian arm, KSrelief, to support the Yemeni people and alleviate their suffering.
    
    -- SPA
20:02 Local Time 17:02 GMT
